final: SELECT s1.college, s1.total, s1.total * 1.0 / s2.total AS ratio FROM (SELECT m.college AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total FROM income i JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major GROUP BY m.college) s1 JOIN (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM income) s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL
